sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Wingless individuals very similar to lacessitiformis, but the compound eyes slightly larger; ocelli large, close to the compound eyes, almost touching them; the projection of the mesonotum slightly angular. Measurements: body length without wings 7 mm, head width 1.59 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: As in lacessitiformis, but antennal segment 3 usually shorter than segment 2. Measurements: body length 3.5—4 mm, head length including nasus 1.03 mm, head length without nasus 0.8 mm, head width 0.87 mm, pronotum width 0.49 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen: secondary chitinization limited in extent, body length 18 mm, the sides of the abdomen almost unpigmented.

note: Adapted from the species-level description by Holmgren (1913), original in German; it describes the wingless imago, the soldier and the queen, while the worker is recorded in the original as "unbekannt" (unknown). The head length and the pronotum length are damaged by OCR in the scanned text (rendered as "1,gt" and "0,oi") and have not been entered; measurements are in mm.
